title: Who should I check in with regarding my daily duties and assignments?

segments.text: To get started with your seva or if you have any questions during your stay: ​Coordinate with Volunteers & Mentors: You can check in directly with our event volunteers or your assigned mentors upon arrival or at any point during the Mahotsav. ​Task Guidance: They will guide you on current needs, help assign specific tasks that fit your preference or skill set, and ensure you have everything required for a seamless and fulfilling service experience.
